summary: Process switch `reader_waves` (`as_slots_free` | `all_at_once`), at its default today's behaviour: at `all_at_once`, a review or recheck wave of Backlog Planning, Business Analysis, Design System, Execution Planning, Operation or Solution Design starts every reader before waiting on any, as the new switch reference `challenge-review/references/switch-reader_waves-all_at_once.md` defines for every task of those flows. On Codex the coordinator first closes every finished agent thread, a writer between its passes included, because every open spawned thread counts against the session's thread cap; when threads are short it starts the largest inputs first, and every wave's progress message names its size and readers running at once. In one measured project a 12-reader recheck wave ran in batches of at most three for 51 min against a slowest reader of 20.7 min.
